resources.string: Keep tracking working
Stop Android from pausing your bank SMS tracking
Android stops apps that run in the background, and then your bank transactions stop arriving.
All set. PennyWise can keep tracking your bank messages in the background.

Battery: Unrestricted
Stops Android from putting PennyWise to sleep, so your bank transactions arrive on time. Find PennyWise in the list and choose Don\'t optimize.
Background activity
PennyWise is set to Restricted. Open its battery settings and choose Unrestricted.
Keep access when not opened
Turn off \"Pause app activity if unused\" or \"Remove permissions if app is unused\". Otherwise Android takes back PennyWise\'s SMS access after a few months.
Never sleeping apps
Autostart
Prefer not to allow the battery step? Samsung can put PennyWise to sleep, so open this list, tap Add apps and pick PennyWise.
Turn on Autostart for PennyWise. Path: Settings → Apps → Permissions → Background autostart.
For PennyWise, turn off Manage automatically, then turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Path: Settings → Battery → App launch.
Turn on Allow auto launch and Allow background activity for PennyWise. Not on the screen that opens? Look in App info → Battery usage.
Turn on Autostart for PennyWise, then allow it in Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management.
Allow PennyWise under Auto-start in the Phone Master app.
Allow PennyWise under Auto-start Manager in the Mobile Manager app.
Some phones have their own background controls. In App info, turn on anything like Auto launch or Run in background for PennyWise.
Tracking may miss transactions
PennyWise can\'t read your bank SMS. Allow SMS access to keep tracking.
Android has restricted PennyWise in the background.
Battery optimisation can pause PennyWise in the background.
Fix
Hide for a week
